about.label: About
timeline: Stockholm discovers hip hop. Kenny Black is there at the beginning.
Publishes "Electric Boogie: When Hip Hop Came to Sweden 1982–1988"
Founds Finest Blend Recordings — electro-funk inspired Detroit music
Establishes Soul Corner — the definitive Stockholm deep house residency
Launches DJ School — teaching the craft from vinyl up for all ages
Still going. Still vinyl. Still ahead of the curve.
bio: Kenny Black is not just a DJ — he is a chapter in Swedish music history. When hip hop arrived in Stockholm in 1982, Kenny was in the room.
As the founder of Finest Blend Recordings and author of Electric Boogie: When Hip Hop Came to Sweden, Kenny brings scholarship and soul to everything he touches.
Behind the decks, his approach is simple: vinyl first, crowd always.
His DJ School passes the knowledge forward — hands-on vinyl and digital training for beginners to advanced students of all ages.
